epa.label: One act
epa.text: The European Product Act as one act that merges the New Legislative Framework, the Market Surveillance Regulation and the Standardisation Regulation. The separate proposal for a New Standardisation Regulation of 6 October 2026 would then be folded into it.

epa.label: Package of two acts
epa.text: Two acts negotiated side by side, the New Standardisation Regulation (proposed on 6 October 2026) and one act on market surveillance and the New Legislative Framework. The package is complete when both are published.

items.label: Sectoral alignment omnibus
items.text: Changes to the sector laws, such as the Machinery Regulation, that align them with the European Product Act. The Commission intends to propose them together with it, so the forecast assumes the same day. Which of the product laws it will change is open, and Parliament and Council have not yet given their views.
